card.name: Legal and government regulation nouns
card.fires_on: Nouns like protection, standards, government and licence that follow a legal or governmental modifier such as patent, state, safety or human rights.

modes.label: Protection after a legal area
modes.description: The word protection or protects after a noun naming a right or legal field.
modes.example: would confer patent<< protection>> on the resulting plants

modes.label: State government or standards
modes.description: Government or standards right after the word state or safety.
modes.example: approved safety<< standards>> for atomic power plants

modes.label: Licence as a permit
modes.description: The word Licence after a government office title.
modes.example: hold a Governor's<< Licence>>, the fee for which is 1
